status: 겨울에 드물게 찾아옴, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만

months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이며, 사진으로 남은 기록은 아직 없다.

summary: 겨울에 드물게 찾아오는 바다새로 지금까지 기록이 10건이 안 되며, 1–2월에 경북 구룡포와 강원 동해 앞바다에서 날아가는 무리가 관찰되었다. 오호츠크해와 베링해, 쿠릴·알류샨 열도의 섬에서 바위가 쌓인 비탈과 벼랑 틈에 큰 무리를 이루어 번식한다. 크릴 같은 작은 갑각류를 주로 잡아먹는다.

art.subject: Crested Auklet (Aethia cristatella), adult in winter, as on the East Sea: entirely dark slate-grey, blackish on the crown and back and slightly paler grey on the underparts; a tuft of black feathers rising from the forehead and curling forward over the bill; a thin white plume running back from behind the eye; white iris. Bill short, deep and stubby; in winter smaller and dull brownish-orange, without the bright orange plates of the breeding season; legs and feet dark grey.
art.pose: floating low on the water, side view, crest curled forward over the bill
art.scene: Grey winter sea off Korea's east coast, low swell under a cold overcast sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view floating low on the sea: small, chunky auk, dark slate-grey all over with no white on the underparts, black forehead crest curling forward over the bill, shorter than in summer, single thin white plume running back from behind the eye, white iris, short stubby bill, small and dull

adult winter, front three-quarter view swimming: forward-curling black crest drooping over the bill, thin white plume behind the eye, white iris, small dull stubby bill, dark slate-grey throat and breast with no white anywhere on the underparts
art.build: Small, chunky auk with a big head, no visible neck and a short, stubby bill; about the size of an Ancient Murrelet and much smaller than a pigeon. Floats low and buoyantly on the sea and dives often; legs short and set far back. Wings short and narrow, whirring fast in low flight over the waves; wings uniformly dark without white markings. Tail very short.
avoid: Do not paint white underparts; unlike the Ancient Murrelet and most other auks, the Crested Auklet is dark grey all over.
Do not paint three white facial plumes (Whiskered Auklet, Aethia pygmaea); the Crested Auklet has one thin white plume behind the eye.
Do not make the crest sweep backward; it curls forward over the bill.
Do not paint a dark iris, or a large, bright orange puffin-like bill; the winter bill is small and dull brownish-orange.
